# add_pbc_to_rag { #mofography.compute.add_pbc_to_rag }

```python
compute.add_pbc_to_rag(rag, pbc_groups)
```

Add a `pbc_group` attribute to each RAG node from the PBC groups.

It takes a RAG and a list of PBC groups, and adds a 'pbc_group' attribute to each node in the RAG

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name       | Type   | Description                                                                      | Default    |
|------------|--------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| rag        |        | the region adjacency graph                                                       | _required_ |
| pbc_groups |        | a list of lists of labels that are in the same periodic boundary condition group | _required_ |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type   | Description                                            |
|--------|--------|--------------------------------------------------------|
|        |        | A rag with the pbc_group attribute added to each node. |
